'''Diseased Sponges''' are Sponges that have been filled with Dead Blood.

==''Obtainment''==
Diseased Sponges can be obtained by placing a Sponge inside liquid Dead Blood, which will be absorbed and disappear.

==''Usage''==
Diseased Sponges can be brewed with Water Bottles or Awkward Potions to create [[Dead Blood Fluid]] and are the one of only two ways of obtaining it, alongside taking the fluid from a source block. However, upon brewing, the Sponge will be consumed and unable to be reused.
